directive.title: Dataset Reconnaissance, Multilingual Literature & Candidate Formulation Directive
directive.version: v2 (template-first; adds the Candidate Formulation mandate)
directive.framing: AUDIT-ONLY / EVIDENCE-ONLY: discovery, recommendation, and draft formulation only — no acquisition, no execution authorization. Rights review and lab execution remain human steps.

owner_classes.LOOP: Autonomous — the lane fleet executes these.
owner_classes.HUMAN: Governance/rights — the loop is FORBIDDEN from executing these; it files and tracks them only.
owner_classes.LAB: Wet-lab execution — requires contracted counterparties and signed candidate-bound returns.

obligations.title: Probe: what web reconnaissance can a headless fire actually do?
obligations.done_criteria: Signed receipt reporting the fire's usable tool inventory (WebSearch/WebFetch/raw HTTP), one native-script query round-trip (Chinese or Japanese) with the native query string and a result sample quoted, and an explicit no-acquisition attestation. This receipt is the factual basis on which the DR-LANG items run full or degraded.
obligations.attack: Attempt each candidate access path in turn and record exactly what worked, what was refused, and what was unavailable, with the evidence inline.
obligations.refutation_criterion: The receipt claims a tool or access path that the transcript does not show being exercised, or omits one that was.
obligations.note: Operator-derived: the directive mandates multilingual search; nothing in the loop had ever verified the tooling exists headless. Not founder text.

obligations.title: Publish the evaluation rubric; prove it deterministic
obligations.done_criteria: Signed rubric artifact covering at least the six mandated dimensions (gap fit, provenance & measurement quality, rights clarity, uniqueness, integrity risk, acquisition cost & friction), each with a scoring rule a second party could apply; byte-stable two-replay of the ranking over a frozen candidate snapshot. RECON-MODE rules apply (see prompt): read-to-evaluate ONLY -- no downloads, no dataset caching, no scraping loops; native-script citations preserved beside any romanization; translation-confidence rated, never silently accepted; units as published with conversions shown; every credited artifact is a DSSE receipt content-binding the ledger lines it appended.
obligations.attack: Re-run the published rubric over the same frozen snapshot and attack determinism; then mutate one scored attribute in a snapshot copy (e.g. flip a license) and attack whether the rank moves as the rubric says it must.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Re-running the published rubric over the same frozen candidate snapshot yields a different ranking or verdict for any candidate, or any of the six mandated dimensions has no scoring rule a second party could apply.

obligations.title: Consolidate the gap register the search is anchored to
obligations.done_criteria: Signed gap register in which every row states the four mandated facts: what measurement or label class is missing, at what minimum n, under what measurement standard, and what a qualifying dataset would have to contain. Sources: every open data-acquisition-queue ask, every Pre-Tier-0 promotion blocker naming a dataset, every lab-in-the-loop spec referencing an external corpus, and every MODELED/ASSUMED recipe element already published at the register's snapshot date. The recipe-gap coupling is circular by design: folding CF-TIER's later deltas into the register is DR-FRESH's run-2 obligation, not this item's -- module serialization means this register closes before CF-TIER exists. RECON-MODE rules apply (see prompt): read-to-evaluate ONLY -- no downloads, no dataset caching, no scraping loops; native-script citations preserved beside any romanization; translation-confidence rated, never silently accepted; units as published with conversions shown; every credited artifact is a DSSE receipt content-binding the ledger lines it appended.
obligations.attack: Audit the register against its own declared sources: delete a known queue-derived gap from a copy and attack whether the completeness check fires; hunt for a queue ask, promotion blocker, or lab-spec corpus reference absent from the register.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any gap row lacks one of the four mandated statements, or a data ask live in the queue at the register's snapshot date, a promotion blocker naming a dataset, or a MODELED or ASSUMED recipe element published before that snapshot is absent from the register.

obligations.done_criteria: Dataset-ledger entries and search-record lines for the Chinese literature communities (CNKI/Wanfang-class indexes, GB/T standards annexes, CAS institute archives and wherever the research leads), queried in native practitioner terminology -- not translated English keywords. Every entry carries the native-script citation, license as published, standard mapping, translation confidence, and the gap or recipe element it serves. An empty result for a gap is a valid, reportable answer. Previously-supplied candidates in these languages must be independently rediscovered or their absence explained. RECON-MODE rules apply (see prompt): read-to-evaluate ONLY -- no downloads, no dataset caching, no scraping loops; native-script citations preserved beside any romanization; translation-confidence rated, never silently accepted; units as published with conversions shown; every credited artifact is a DSSE receipt content-binding the ledger lines it appended.
obligations.attack: Spot-check the ledger and search record against the live sources: re-resolve citations, re-fetch license pages, compare recorded queries against what a practitioner would write, and check rediscovery recall against the known candidate list; corrupt one citation in a ledger copy and attack whether the audit fires.
obligations.refutation_criterion: A spot-check finds a claimed-searched repository with no recorded query and result sample, a native-language query that is a literal English translation, a cited source whose recorded license text differs from its live license page, a native-script citation that fails to resolve, or a previously-supplied candidate in this language that the fresh search neither rediscovered nor explained.

An unmapped standard in the ledger is an integrity gap and must be declared as one. RECON-MODE rules apply (see prompt): read-to-evaluate ONLY -- no downloads, no dataset caching, no scraping loops; native-script citations preserved beside any romanization; translation-confidence rated, never silently accepted; units as published with conversions shown; every credited artifact is a DSSE receipt content-binding the ledger lines it appended.

obligations.title: Disposition Ledger: every candidate gets exactly one verdict
obligations.done_criteria: First deliverable: a sha256-pinned candidate-intake manifest enumerating every previously-furnished source (each source named inside the 14 data-acquisition-queue lines, the six B-ASK asks R-D01..R-D06, and U-MLIP's Orb reference) -- 'every candidate' is only checkable against a closed input set. Then: every manifest candidate and every engine-discovered candidate receives exactly one of RECOMMENDED, CONDITIONAL (blocker named and routed to a human action), or REJECTED (specific disqualifying finding). 'Not selected' without a reason is not a permitted state. A RECOMMENDED entry with an empty serves field is a defect. Byte-stable replay over the same snapshot. RECON-MODE rules apply (see prompt): read-to-evaluate ONLY -- no downloads, no dataset caching, no scraping loops; native-script citations preserved beside any romanization; translation-confidence rated, never silently accepted; units as published with conversions shown; every credited artifact is a DSSE receipt content-binding the ledger lines it appended.
obligations.attack: Remove one queue-derived candidate's verdict from a copy and attack whether the every-candidate check fires; hunt for a manifest candidate with zero or two verdicts, and for a RECOMMENDED entry serving nothing.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any candidate in the pinned intake manifest or any engine-discovered candidate lacks exactly one verdict of RECOMMENDED, CONDITIONAL or REJECTED with a stated reason, or a RECOMMENDED entry has an empty serves field, or the disposition replay over the same snapshot is not byte-stable.

obligations.title: Coverage Map: no gap left blank
obligations.done_criteria: Signed gap-by-gap (and, once CF-TIER exists, recipe-element-by-element) map in which every row carries exactly one of: the best RECOMMENDED source, the best CONDITIONAL source, or an explicit conversion into a commissioned-measurement candidate for the lab-in-the-loop program. An empty search result converts; it never pads and never disappears. RECON-MODE rules apply (see prompt): read-to-evaluate ONLY -- no downloads, no dataset caching, no scraping loops; native-script citations preserved beside any romanization; translation-confidence rated, never silently accepted; units as published with conversions shown; every credited artifact is a DSSE receipt content-binding the ledger lines it appended.
obligations.attack: Blank one gap's row in a copy and attack whether the map-completeness check fires; cross-check that every named source exists in the Dataset Ledger.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any register gap or MODELED or ASSUMED recipe element has neither a best recommended source, a best conditional source, nor an explicit commissioned-measurement conversion, or names a source absent from the Dataset Ledger.

Sufficient for a human to audit what was and was not looked at, and for the next run to extend rather than repeat. RECON-MODE rules apply (see prompt): read-to-evaluate ONLY -- no downloads, no dataset caching, no scraping loops; native-script citations preserved beside any romanization; translation-confidence rated, never silently accepted; units as published with conversions shown; every credited artifact is a DSSE receipt content-binding the ledger lines it appended.
obligations.attack: Strip one repository's query log from a copy and attack whether the audit detects a ledger entry with no matching search provenance; check the extension decisions exist and are reasoned.
obligations.refutation_criterion: The record omits a language community or repository class that any ledger entry's own provenance shows was used, omits the native-language query forms, or omits the considered-and-excluded decision for language communities beyond the twelve named.

obligations.title: Discovery Annex: quarantine holds
obligations.done_criteria: Signed check that the annex exists (superior chemistries, alternative feedstocks, adjacent systems and adjacent-problem sources are REPORTED, not suppressed) and that the quarantine is airtight: no annex entry appears in the primary Dataset Ledger or primary recipe, and no primary-recipe element cites annex evidence. RECON-MODE rules apply (see prompt): read-to-evaluate ONLY -- no downloads, no dataset caching, no scraping loops; native-script citations preserved beside any romanization; translation-confidence rated, never silently accepted; units as published with conversions shown; every credited artifact is a DSSE receipt content-binding the ledger lines it appended.
obligations.attack: Copy one annex chemistry into a primary-BOM copy and attack whether the disjointness check fires; grep the primary artifacts for annex identifiers.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any annex entry also appears in the primary Dataset Ledger or the primary recipe, or any primary-recipe element cites an annex entry as its evidence, or a non-envelope-conforming chemistry appears outside the annex.

obligations.title: Freshness: every run diffs against the last
obligations.done_criteria: Every ledger carries snapshot_date, run_id and an explicit diff block against the prior run (new sources, changed licenses, superseded datasets, tier movements) -- run 1 must state 'first run — no prior ledger' explicitly, which is itself checkable. No recommendation or recipe element is ever silently carried forward: re-verified or re-flagged. RECON-MODE rules apply (see prompt): read-to-evaluate ONLY -- no downloads, no dataset caching, no scraping loops; native-script citations preserved beside any romanization; translation-confidence rated, never silently accepted; units as published with conversions shown; every credited artifact is a DSSE receipt content-binding the ledger lines it appended.
obligations.attack: Carry one stale entry forward unmarked in a copy and attack whether the diff check fires; verify run 1's explicit first-run declaration exists.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any run's ledger lacks a snapshot date and an explicit diff block against the prior run or an explicit first-run declaration, or any prior recommendation appears unchanged without a re-verified or re-flagged mark, or run 2's register fails to fold in CF-TIER's MODELED and ASSUMED elements (DR-GAP's declared second pass).
obligations.unblock_condition: Second sweep scheduled (run 2); run 1 satisfies only the first-run declaration, which DR-LANG receipts carry.
obligations.note: Filed blocked until a second sweep exists to diff against; the obligation is declared now so coverage accounting sees it.

obligations.source_heading: ## 7. Candidate Formulation Package (Mandate B deliverable — floor, not ceiling)
obligations.title: Envelope arithmetic: the recipe lands its numbers, shown not asserted
obligations.done_criteria: Signed artifact showing the mass balance and EEW/AHEW stoichiometry by which the candidate formulation lands the 1:1 volume mix ratio, 65±2% volume solids, ≤340 g/L VOC, pot-life and DFT targets -- every envelope number cited by path+sha256 to amphora-envelope-gates/reference/mvp20/charter/v5_requirements.json, never restated freehand (thresholds are never relaxed, so the charter file is the only permitted source of them). Independent re-computation must reproduce the shown arithmetic.
obligations.attack: Re-derive the arithmetic independently; perturb one ingredient density in a BOM copy and attack whether the re-computation breaches a target and the check fires; diff every envelope constant against the charter file.
obligations.refutation_criterion: The shown mass-balance and stoichiometry, independently re-computed, fails to land the 1:1 volume mix, 65±2% volume solids, or ≤340 g/L VOC targets as cited from the charter, or any envelope number in the blueprint differs from that file.

obligations.source_heading: ## 7. Candidate Formulation Package (Mandate B deliverable — floor, not ceiling)
obligations.title: Formulation & BOM: every raw material, function, loading, source, tier
obligations.done_criteria: Signed blueprint section: every raw material in both components (resin, curative, solvents, pigments, extenders, additives) with function, target % by weight, key grade/spec attributes, at least one candidate commercial source with the domestic-sourcing preference flagged, and an evidence tier on every numeric claim. Chemistry stays inside the two-component epoxy-polyamide solvent-borne envelope; superior non-conforming ideas go to the Discovery Annex.
obligations.attack: Delete one BOM line's EEW citation in a copy and attack whether the completeness check fires; hunt for an uncited or untiered numeric claim; check envelope conformance of every ingredient class.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any BOM line lacks function, target weight percent, grade or spec attributes, or a candidate commercial source, or any numeric claim about an ingredient is uncited and untiered.

obligations.source_heading: ## 7. Candidate Formulation Package (Mandate B deliverable — floor, not ceiling)
obligations.title: Mixing, induction, application and bench-scale process
obligations.done_criteria: Signed blueprint section: component A/B preparation, induction behavior, thinning limits, application parameters against the envelope's WFT/coverage/cure schedule, and the bench-scale mix/dispersion sequence with scale-sensitive steps flagged for the later pilot path.
obligations.attack: Remove the induction-time parameter from a copy and attack whether the envelope crosswalk fires; walk the envelope's application table and hunt for an uncovered parameter.
obligations.refutation_criterion: The mixing, induction and application section or the bench-scale sequence omits a parameter the envelope's WFT, coverage or cure schedule requires, or a scale-sensitive step is unflagged.

obligations.source_heading: ## 7. Candidate Formulation Package (Mandate B deliverable — floor, not ceiling)
obligations.title: Per-element evidence tiers: the crosswalk that couples recipe and ledger
obligations.done_criteria: Every ingredient choice, loading level and process parameter tagged MEASURED (cited primary data) / MODELED (method named) / ASSUMED (rationale stated), each with a confidence rating; every MODELED/ASSUMED element cross-references the Dataset Ledger entry or commissioned measurement that would harden it. This crosswalk is mandatory -- it is how the recipe and the ledger justify each other, and its gap deltas feed DR-GAP's second pass. Hidden uncertainty is a violation; declared uncertainty is the deliverable working as intended.
obligations.attack: Strip one element's cross-reference in a copy and attack whether the crosswalk check fires; hunt for an untagged element or a tag with no confidence rating.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any ingredient choice, loading or process parameter lacks a MEASURED, MODELED or ASSUMED tag with a confidence rating, or any MODELED or ASSUMED element fails to cross-reference a resolving Dataset Ledger entry or commissioned measurement.

obligations.source_heading: ## 7. Candidate Formulation Package (Mandate B deliverable — floor, not ceiling)
obligations.title: Alternates: the lab tests a decision, not a guess
obligations.done_criteria: Wherever evidence cannot distinguish candidate ingredients (two curatives, two thinner systems), the blueprint ships the primary plus ranked alternates with the discriminating experiment named.
obligations.attack: Merge two curative alternates into one unexplained pick in a copy and attack whether the check fires; hunt for an evidence-indistinguishable pair shipped without a discriminating experiment.
obligations.refutation_criterion: Any pair of evidence-indistinguishable candidates ships without ranked alternates and a named discriminating experiment.

obligations.source_heading: ## 7. Candidate Formulation Package (Mandate B deliverable — floor, not ceiling)
obligations.title: Pre-registered test plan and the data-capture template
obligations.done_criteria: Signed protocol qualifying the system against the envelope and the relevant MIL-DTL-24441-class requirements, conforming to the portfolio's common transfer path: methods and standards named, acceptance thresholds and kill criteria locked before any measurement, splits declared, uncertainty quantified (not point-only) -- PLUS the candidate-bound data-capture template (measurements, conditions, deviations, outcomes, units specified) so bench results flow back to fine-tune the engine.
obligations.attack: Delete one kill criterion from a copy and attack whether the pre-registration completeness check fires; verify the capture template binds to the candidate and specifies units on every field.
obligations.refutation_criterion: The test plan lacks named methods and standards, pre-locked acceptance thresholds and kill criteria, declared splits, quantified uncertainty, or the candidate-bound unit-specified data-capture template.

obligations.source_heading: ## 7. Candidate Formulation Package (Mandate B deliverable — floor, not ceiling)
obligations.title: Known failure modes, application limits, mitigations
obligations.done_criteria: Signed blueprint section: pinholing/wetting/film-build and pot-life risks specific to this recipe, the application-limit parameters most likely to be exceeded, and their mitigations. An element the engine cannot defend is reported as such with its resolving experiment -- an honest hole is compliant; a confident-looking guess is not.
obligations.attack: Drop the pot-life mitigation from a copy and attack whether the check fires; hunt for a named risk with no exceeded-parameter or no mitigation.
